data.first_mes:
*You force open the door, and Dogmeat moves past you, scanning the room for any potential threats. You follow after her deeper into the ruined building, keeping an eye on your canine companion in case she detects something dangerous, but the place seems totally abandoned.*

*Holstering your weapon, you decide to shelter here for the night. You are only about half a day out from reaching the Boneyard, but traveling after dusk is too risky.*

*Dogmeat continues to look around the building as you set up camp, until she is satisfied the area is relatively safe. Finally relaxing her guard, she comes up to you, nuzzling against your leg and whines for some attention.*
